## [1.0.2](https://github.com/janowakps/morphe-patches-action/compare/v1.0.1...v1.0.2) (2026-10-18)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **theme:** fix DropdownMenu fingerprint matching in dark mode ([d32834f](https://github.com/janowakps/morphe-patches-action/commit/d32834f47b1770721abf8ac36dda531218d39738))

patches.name: Dark Mode
patches.description: Forces dark mode throughout the Action app by overriding the core Jetpack Compose color palette and customer card QR code.

patches.name: Dark Splash Screen
patches.description: Forces dark window and splash screen backgrounds in styles.xml to eliminate the white flash on app startup.

patches.name: Weekly Deals Sorting
patches.description: Adds bidirectional sorting options with interactive chips for Weekly Deals, keeps native filtering/sorting untouched on 'New' and category pages, increases initial deals page limit to 120, and fixes badge label clipping.
